pages.title: Drive cartridge
findings: Gearbox flange seats concentrically on the already fitted motor. Four upper washer/screw sites remain distinct and visible from both inspection angles; previews and installed screw axes agree with the flange bores.

All nine before/preview/installed placements inspected. Screw heads bear on washers, with the shaft direction entering the receiver rather than projecting out of the head side. No visible inversion or displaced installed mesh found.
Raw end HUD, current manual contact sheet and working view show9/9; supplies list gearbox×1,washer×4,screw×4. The receiving motor is clearly starting context.

pages.title: Enclose the drive
findings: Housing preview surrounds the exposed motor/lead-screw/rod cartridge. Opaque end silhouette encloses the drive; service images preserve visibility of the receiving seats.

Four rear-entry motor pairs and two radial retainer pairs inspected at both angles. The exposed-view mode intentionally hides the barrel, making its external washers appear unsupported; direct service close-ups show their bearing surfaces on the transparent housing. No new visible interference with the lead screw, retainer or upper rod observed.
HUD instruction names the motor and retainer as already fitted context, lists only barrel×1,washer×6,screw×6 and advances0/13→13/13.

pages.title: Base eye
findings: Base eye seats at the rear cap without closing the crosswise pin opening. Spherical bearing enters the housing shoulder concentrically and the retaining ring sits on the exposed retaining side.

Both eye fastener pairs inspected before/preview/installed from both sides. Washers remain on the accessible faces, screw axes enter the bosses, and the eye bore stays open. No visible mirrored bearing or clip inversion found.
HUD distinguishes Base eye housing from the Rod variant and counts the seven new supplies correctly; end progress7/7.

pages.title: Rod eye
findings: Rod eye seats on the rod-end flange with a clear crosswise pin bore. Bearing and retaining ring remain concentric with the eye housing in both inspection angles.

Both rod-eye fastener pairs inspected. Heads remain on the exposed flange face, washers contact that face, and the fastening axes do not cross the eye opening. No visible shaft/rod/eye interference found in these views.
HUD distinguishes Rod eye housing, lists the seven supplies with shared bearing/ring family names, and advances0/7→7/7.

pages.title: Ready to install
findings: Readiness page is a status summary with91/91 assembly components and no new-supplies shopping list. Prepared diagram and opaque silhouette show the full actuator with both complete eyes.

Opaque and service views from both angles retain both eyes, external guide/sensor hardware and closed housing. Exposed inspection reveals the internal drive while the opaque view preserves the closed appearance.

Twelve sampled rendered frames of continuous station rotation inspected: both eyes and external hardware follow the body without visible separation. This supplements the behavior measurements; it is not a high-resolution dynamic clearance certificate.
